title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi on 19.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 19/10/2026

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 19/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 19.10.2026;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi would not be available.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Aniruddha P.
Mayee) would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi.)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
